tasks.short: Join recruitment and file a studio placement.

steps.what: Read open places for the recruitment round from the student record.
Participate in recruitment activities with each prospective student.
Name the studio placement for this applicant.
File registration v1 in the student record.
Check registration v1 quotes the studio placement.

tasks.design: She meets each prospective student and names the studio, and a separate step files registration v1 in the student record ({OTHER}). She checks that version against the studio she named. No offer is sent, and no admission alert is raised.
tasks.previous_blocker: The studio name only exists after she has met the applicant, so a form could not be filled in advance.
tasks.enabler_now: A record app can write the studio name she has already spoken, once the admissions officer has stored the open places.
tasks.still_hard: Whether this applicant belongs in that studio is still her judgement, and a blank places card still means she asks.
tasks.human_edge: She hears the applicant and names the studio. The file does not choose the placement or the admission.
tasks.altitude: She still meets every prospective student and still names the studio. She does not gain a right to file a placement she has not named, or to admit the applicant.

reach.task: Store open places before the recruitment round.
reach.learn: Which programme name, places left and audition date are already stored, so a blank card is not filled with a guessed number.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge, not a measured study of this school: meeting applicants and naming the studio are the bulk of this task. Filing a studio she has already named is the small slice.
Annex III point 3 covers admission and evaluating learning outcomes. This registration records a studio name she chose. It does not decide admission and it does not set a grade.
Works-council consent is required before a system monitors staff. This registration stores the studio name. It does not log her speed or her hours.

assumptions: The admissions officer stores programme name, places left and audition date before the open day, outside this task. That capture is not counted as saved. If any of those is blank, the read does not run and she asks. She does not quote a number.

She names the studio herself in the placement step, at full time. Registration v1 is filed only after that name exists. She then checks that version against the studio she named. A later change voids the file.
No offer is sent, to the applicant or to anyone else. No admission alert is raised. The record does not set a grade.
The record stores the studio name. It does not store her hours, her speed, or a location trail.
unknowns: Whether the admissions officer, rather than she, files the studio today.
Whether programme name, places left and audition date are already stored before the open day.
research_questions: Which of programme name, places left and audition date is already on the student record before the open day?

incremental.description: When the filed studio is not the one she named, correct registration v1 before it stands.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low is an open day where the places card is blank, so she asks and writes nothing. High is 5, only filing registration v1 after she has named the studio and checked that version. Meeting applicants and naming the studio stay.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Work through teaching and research issues.

steps.what: Collaborate with colleagues and hear the teaching issue.
Decide how the group will address the research issues.
File the agreed note as teaching note v1.
Check teaching note v1 states the agreed research issues.

tasks.design: She hears the teaching issue and the group agrees the change, and a separate step files teaching note v1 in the {DOCS}. She checks that version against the change they agreed. The note is not emailed, and no proposal is uploaded.
tasks.previous_blocker: The agreed change only exists after the group has talked, so a note could not be written before the meeting.
tasks.enabler_now: A document app can store the change they have already agreed, in their own words.
tasks.still_hard: What to change in the teaching, and whether a research question is even in scope, stays with the people in the room.
tasks.human_edge: She hears her colleagues and takes part in the decision. The note does not decide the teaching issue.
tasks.altitude: She still sits with colleagues and still decides the change. The note does not decide the teaching issue for her.

reach.task: Bring the teaching or research issue to the meeting.
reach.learn: Which class and which research question are already named, so the note does not invent them.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge, not a measured study of this school: the meeting is the bulk of this task. Writing down a change the group has already agreed is the small slice.
NWO says referees may not use generative AI, and uploading a proposal breaches confidentiality. This note is an internal teaching agreement. It is not a grant proposal, and it is not uploaded.
Works-council consent is required before a system monitors staff. This note stores the agreed change. It does not log her speed or her hours.

assumptions: A colleague teacher brings the class and the research question. If neither is named, the file does not run and the meeting stays talk only. That naming is the meeting itself, at full time, and is not counted as saved.

Teaching note v1 is filed only after the group has agreed the change. She then checks that the version states those research issues. If they have not agreed, the file does not run. A later change voids the file.
The note is not emailed to colleagues or to anyone outside. No proposal is drafted or uploaded. No alert is raised.
The note stores the agreed change. It does not store her hours, her speed, or a location trail.
unknowns: Whether the group already keeps a written note, or only talks.
Whether a research issue in this meeting is ever a grant proposal.
research_questions: Does she already write the agreed class change before anyone else files it?

incremental.description: When the filed note does not state the agreed change, correct teaching note v1 before it stands.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low is a meeting where the group does not agree, so no note is filed. High is 3, only filing teaching note v1 after the agreed change is named and checked. Hearing colleagues and deciding stay.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Advise students on curricula and careers.

steps.what: Read the module list from the student record.
Advise students on academic and vocational curricula and career issues.

tasks.design: She reads the module list from the student record ({OTHER}), then advises the students herself. No advice letter is sent, no model drafts the advice, and no grade is set.
tasks.previous_blocker: The advice depends on the student in front of her, so a letter could not be prepared as the advice itself.
tasks.enabler_now: The programme coordinator can keep module name, year and prerequisite on the student record, so she opens a list instead of hunting for the printed card.
tasks.still_hard: What to say about this student's path is still her conversation, and a blank list still means the printed card.
tasks.human_edge: She advises the student. The module list does not tell her what to say and does not set a grade.
tasks.altitude: She still advises every student. The module list does not tell her what to say, and she gains no right to set a grade.

reach.task: Keep the module list current before the advice meeting.
reach.learn: Which module name, year and prerequisite are already stored, so a blank list is not treated as advice.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge, not a measured study of this school: the conversation is essentially the whole task. Opening a module list the coordinator has already stored is the small slice.
Annex III point 3 covers evaluating learning outcomes and admission. This advice does not set a grade or an admission.
Works-council consent is required before a system monitors staff. This module read does not log her speed or her hours.

assumptions: The programme coordinator stores module name, year and prerequisite before the meeting, outside this task. That capture is not counted as saved. If any of those is blank, the read does not run and she uses the printed module card.
She advises the students herself, at full time. The list is not advice. No advice letter is sent. No model drafts what she says. No grade is set, and no alert is raised.
The read shows module name, year and prerequisite. It does not store her hours, her speed, or a location trail.
unknowns: Whether module name, year and prerequisite are already on a list she can open.
Whether a study advisor, rather than she, holds the career conversation.
research_questions: Which of module name, year and prerequisite is already stored before the student sits down?

incremental.description: When the module list names the wrong year, tell the programme coordinator and use the printed card.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low is a blank module list, so she uses the printed card and the read does not run. High is 1, only the module-list read when the coordinator has already stored module name, year and prerequisite. Advising students stays.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Take part in campus and community events.

steps.what: Hear which campus and community events need her.
Choose the piece she will show.
File campus date v1 on the calendar.
Check campus date v1 names the event and the piece.
Participate in the campus and community events.

tasks.design: She chooses the piece, and a separate step files campus date v1 on the {CALENDAR}. She checks that version, then takes part. No public notice is sent.
tasks.previous_blocker: The piece only exists as her choice after she has heard which event it is, so a calendar block could not be filled in advance.
tasks.enabler_now: A calendar app can store the event and the piece she has already chosen, once she has heard the date.
tasks.still_hard: Which piece to show, and whether she goes, stay her decision. Hearing the event too late still means she just goes.
tasks.human_edge: She chooses the piece and takes part. The calendar block does not decide whether she goes and does not speak for her.
tasks.altitude: She still chooses the piece and still takes part. The calendar block does not decide whether she goes.

reach.task: Name the campus or community event before she chooses a piece.
reach.learn: Which event name, date and place are already set, so she does not block a date she has not heard.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge, not a measured study of this school: showing up is almost the whole task. Blocking a date she has already heard is the small slice.
Emotion inference in education is banned. This calendar block names the event and the piece. It does not infer emotion.
Works-council consent is required before a system monitors staff. This calendar block does not log her speed or her hours.

assumptions: She hears event name, date and place herself, at full time. The events officer may have set them, but this task does not read a card, and that capture is not counted as saved. If she has not heard the event, the file does not run.

She chooses the piece herself, at full time. Campus date v1 is filed only after that choice. She then checks that the version names the event and the piece. A later change voids the file. She can still take part if the file did not run.
No public notice is sent, and the date is not emailed to colleagues or to anyone outside. No alert is raised.
The calendar block stores the event and the piece. It does not store her hours, her speed, or a location trail, and it does not infer emotion.
unknowns: Whether she already blocks the date on a calendar, or only hears the event.
Whether the events officer, rather than she, publishes the appearance.
research_questions: Which of event name, date and place does she hear before she chooses the piece?

incremental.description: When the filed date is not the event she heard, correct campus date v1 before it stands.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low is an event she hears too late to block, so she just goes and the file does not run. High is 1, only filing campus date v1 after she has chosen the piece and checked that version. Taking part stays.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: She still meets prospective students, still places them by judgement, still advises students on curricula and careers, still works through teaching and research issues with colleagues, and still takes part in campus and community events. The registration, the teaching note and the calendar block do not choose those acts.
reach: admissions officer (which programme name, places left and audition date are already stored)
programme coordinator (which module name, year and prerequisite are already stored)
colleague teacher (which class and research question are already named)
events officer (which event name, date and place are already set)
skills_to_grow: Refuse registration v1 until the studio is one she named.
Treat a blank module list as a blank and use the printed module card.
Refuse campus date v1 until the event and the piece are ones she chose.
role.ambitious_version: She files the studio the same day she names it, and the teaching note only after the group has agreed. The meeting, the advice and the event stay hers.
